title: abelmoschus manihot var. mindanaensis
intro: Abelmoschus manihot var. mindanaensis, commonly known as the Mindanao okra, is a variant of the Abelmoschus manihot plant, a member of the Malvaceae family. It is known to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its high content of antioxidants and fiber. The therapeutic actions of Abelmoschus manihot var. mindanaensis include its use as an antidiabetic, antihypertensive, and anti-inflammatory agent, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and potential health benefits of this plant.
